🎬 Grow (2025)

Grow follows Charlie, a young girl who moves to the countryside to live with her aunt Dinah after experiencing a difficult period in her life. Struggling to adjust to her new surroundings, Charlie discovers an unexpected passion for growing pumpkins and enters a local competition where farmers compete to produce the biggest pumpkin. With the help of her aunt and new friends, she begins an extraordinary adventure filled with unusual challenges, friendly rivalries, and surprising discoveries. As the competition becomes increasingly intense, Charlie learns that success requires more than simply growing something enormous. Through hilarious moments, heartwarming friendships, and a little magic, Grow celebrates family, determination, teamwork, and the importance of believing in yourself.

🎭 Genre: Adventure • Comedy • Family

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 47m • PG

🎥 Director: John McPhail
